events.title: Awards
events.description: DramaKing received Medal of Honor. Waiting... and Meowth received King Decade. Mech received Quickly Loved. Fish received Stanley Fan. Yanix received the Octoberfest 2025 award.

events.title: Group & Crew News
events.description: Succubus, Olympians, Benevolence, and Mystery Inc remain listed for sale. Casino was recently sold to NERO. No leadership changes this week.

events.title: The Academy Octoberfest Award Progress Tracker
events.description: - by Octoberfest vibes are in full swing, and @Charlie Sheen@ delivered the perfect utility for the season, a Tampermonkey script that tracks your October posts and threads in real time. With a clean UI, auto-refresh, and Halloween-themed flair, it's the easiest way to monitor your award progress without lifting a finger. An awesome example of coding meets community spirit.

events.title: HACKFORUMS DASH: Complete API Dashboard & Automation Platform
events.description: - by launched a game changer - *HackForums Dash*, a full API-based dashboard that gives users total control over their HF accounts. From managing bytes and auto-bumping threads to checking contracts and ratings, it's built with security in mind using .official HF API. A sleek, modern automation suite for power users that pushes the forum’s ecosystem forward in a big way.

events.title: Craziest thing that happened on HF?
events.description: - by Every old-timer on HF has a story or two. From legendary bans to wild exploits and real-life drama, this thread is turning into a living archive of HF lore. If you missed some of the forum's craziest moments, this is your chance to catch up.

events.title: My journey building a tool for doomscrolling awareness + Facebook post analysis
events.description: - by It might feel a bit weird to add one of my own, but I shared a personal journey creating a Chrome extension to combat doomscrolling and analyze Facebook posts. What began as a response to dark algorithmic loops turned into a tool for emotional awareness. A raw, thoughtful post that blends mental health awareness with serious tech craft.
